rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; CKG and PEK samples from two different centers within devCCNP
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The data for model training consists of two samples: the CKG sample and the PEK sample. Samples from the two different centers are both sourced from the developing Chinese Color Nest Project (devCCNP)."

rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Samples from the two different centers are both sourced from the developing Chinese Color Nest Project (devCCNP)."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase healthy sample used to build sex-specific normative models
rci5_n.supporting_text: "We have developed sex-specific normative models on regional subcortical volume, cortical thickness, and surface area data from 457 healthy children sourced from two datasets."

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase healthy sample; sex counts reported for devCCNP normal sample
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "This project enrolled typically developing school-age Chinese children and adolescents, and this study comprised 241 boys and 216 girls, aged 3 to 18 years, with a mean age of 10.44 ± 3.11 years."
